description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.13.0

      A minor release: public members added, none removed or renamed. DxfName moves from DxfUnknownEntity to its base
      DxfEntity, so code that read it there reads it as before.

      NEW, DXF
      - DxfEntity.DxfName is the group 0 name of every entity in its drawing's version (LINE, LWPOLYLINE, INSERT,
        DIMENSION, ACAD_TABLE, REGION): a 2D polyline that is LWPOLYLINE in R2000 is POLYLINE in R12, and an entity made
        in code names its type before it is in a drawing. Only DxfUnknownEntity had it.
      - DxfDatabase.BorrowFonts(path) sets FontSearchPath for the life of the scope it returns and measures in one set of
        fonts that every borrow of the path shares; scopes nest. The GeometricExtents of 2 000 TEXTs in an SHX font took
        102 ms setting and clearing FontSearchPath round each text on .NET Framework 4.8, and 9.6 ms borrowed, the boxes
        the same to the bit.

      FIXED, DXF and DWG
      - WblockCloneObjects copies the field of a TEXT, an MTEXT, an attribute or a dimension, and of each attribute of an
        INSERT copied with it, as AutoCAD's deep clone does, where a title block's \AcVar and \AcSm attributes kept
        their words and lost the FIELD behind them. The copied fields are listed in ACAD_FIELDLIST, as are those of
        FieldFromMText and FieldToMText.
      - A DXF saved from a drawing read from a DWG our writer made is no longer refused by AutoCAD 2021 ("Invalid or
        incomplete DXF input"): the DWG writer writes the handle of ByLayer for a current linetype the header leaves out,
        and the DWG reader names ByLayer, 0 and Standard for a current linetype, layer or text style whose handle names no
        record.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
